places.name: Battersea Park
places.description: A large Thames-side park opened in 1858, near the landmark Battersea Power Station.

history.summary: SW11 lies within Wandsworth. Home to Battersea Power Station, the iconic decommissioned coal-fired station on the Thames, and to Clapham Junction, one of the busiest railway interchanges in Europe despite its name referencing neighbouring Lambeth.
